title: Beck
html_source: Beck, abbreviation of beckoning, meaning at his summons, bidding. Joyce may be playing on words here, for in French, ‘bec’ pronounced the same as the English ‘beck’ means mouth (especially of a bird, a beak but also used for people) or spout.
